rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for the inside of a building, container, or other enclosed place.

example.english: The interior of the cinema is quite nice, with lots of comfortable seats.
example.traditional: 間戲院嘅入面幾靚，仲有好多舒服嘅座位。
example.jyutping: gaan1 hei3 jyun2 ge3 jap6 min6 gei2 leng3 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 syu1 fuk6 ge3 zo6 wai2

rows.note: Use this for inland areas of a country or continent, away from the coast or borders.

example.english: This highway goes deep into the interior, and there are mountains all along the way.
example.traditional: 呢條公路一路伸入內陸，沿途都係山。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 gung1 lou6 jat1 lou6 san1 jap6 noi6 luk6 jyun4 tou4 dou1 hai6 saan1
